test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 30 Jan 2023 Shift 3)

question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution: The correct answer is **"loose."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Loose"** is an adjective that means not tight or not firmly fixed in place. (बंधनमुक्त; खुला) • **Example**: *The horse managed to get **loose**__ and escape.* • The correct word to fill in the blank is **"loose." ** • The correct answer is option 2. • Correct passage: The room looked as though a __hurricane__ had swept through it. The storm had blown __open__ the French doors during the night, and the wind and the rain had wreaked havoc, __scattering__ everything before it. A few __**loose**__ pages of the report lay on the wet rug, but the rest of the pages had obviously been carried ______ (5) ______ by the wind. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Option 1,** "lose,"** is a verb and it means to become unable to find something. ((किसी वस्‍तु को) खो देना, न पा सकना) • Option 3, **"read,**" is a verb and it means to look at words or symbols and understand them. (पढ़ना (शब्‍दों या प्रतीकों को देखना और समझना)) • Option 4, **"tight,"** is a verb and it means fixed firmly in position and difficult to move or remove. (किसी स्‍थान पर कसकर बँधा हुआ (जिसका हिलना या जिसे हिलाना कठिन हो)) 19a:Tf9d, The correct answer is **"away."**
